evals.prompt: Build a painted steel PBR material from basecolor, DirectX normal and ORM for a glTF target.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Uses Non-Color data, declared normal-Y conversion and correct packing by shader.
Preserves shared material/image users and resolves duplicate maps explicitly.
Does not equate DITHERED with glTF MASK or infer portability from graph wiring alone.
